title: Supplier security review — follow-up interview
engine: Azure AI Speech batch transcription (diarization on, EU region)
summary: The supplier confirmed the SOC 2 Type 2 report covers the managed detection service for the period ending 2026-06-30.
Two of the five CUECs in the report are the responsibility of Euronext and were not previously tracked.
The supplier could not confirm whether sub-processor personnel are in scope of the certificate; this is left open.

actions.action: Record the two Euronext-side CUECs in the controls register
Request the sub-processor scope statement in writing

notes: Speaker labels were mapped from the diarization output in the approved contract, not inferred by the renderer.
No normalisation was applied to the recognised text.
sources: Recording filed under Infosec Assurance/GRC/TPA/Active/Placeholder Supplier A/Managed Detection and Response/

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Thanks for making the time. I want to close two points from the evidence review: the period the SOC 2 report covers, and the complementary user entity controls.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Of course. The Type 2 report covers the twelve months ending on the thirtieth of June this year, and the managed detection service is in scope for the whole period.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Good. There are five CUECs listed. My reading is that two of them sit with us rather than with you — the ones about alert triage windows and about maintaining the asset inventory we send you.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: That is correct. Those two are entity responsibilities. The other three are ours and they are covered by the controls tested in the report.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Last one. Does the certificate scope include the personnel of your sub-processors, or only your own staff?

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: I would have to check that with our compliance team. I do not want to answer from memory on something that goes into your assessment.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Understood. I will record it as open and we will take the written scope statement when you have it.
